rules.statement: Linux ships its own CI, version and Git provenance; a Windows bootstrap selects a verified immutable Linux commit. Never infer Linux code from the current Windows branch.
rules.title: Keep Windows and Linux release identities separate
rules.why: Cross-OS branch drift caused the wrong Hermes operator menu to run.

rules.statement: Defer sandbox lifecycle and policy authority to upstream NemoClaw/OpenShell, and never run rebuild, destroy, provider changes or onboarding during a normal status, verify or launch.
rules.title: Preserve vendor-owned agent state
rules.why: A routine restart must not destroy user artifacts or credentials.

rules.statement: Neither install nor verify may require PowerShell, Windows executables, WSL-specific paths or native Windows service processes.
rules.title: Keep native Ubuntu portable
rules.why: The same artifact must work on a native Ubuntu host.

rules.statement: Use the official NemoClaw credential bridge and explicit allowlists for any approved private inference endpoint.
rules.title: Keep secrets out of source and logs
rules.why: Agents remain bounded by upstream security controls.
